instruction: Fix `base64_encode` so it encodes the string's UTF-8 bytes (the current code passes the raw str, which base64 rejects).
gold_patch:
diff --git a/codec.py b/codec.py
--- a/codec.py
+++ b/codec.py
@@ -7,7 +7,7 @@
 
 def base64_encode(data):
     """Base64-encode a string and return the ASCII text."""
-    return base64.b64encode(data)
+    return base64.b64encode(data.encode("utf-8")).decode("ascii")
